mapper.select: SELECT n.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_notice_read r WHERE r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_read ORDER BY n.pinned DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_notice (title, content, category, publisher_id, publisher_name, pinned) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{publisherId}, #{publisherName}, #{pinned})
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_notice SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, category=#{category}, pinned=#{pinned} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE oa_notice SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_notice_read WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM oa_notice n WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM oa_notice_read r WHERE r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId})
